title: ActorSubjectLinkStatusStatementV2
description: AAB-PLATFORM-04 ActorSubjectLinkStatusStatement: what a status record's writer decides, and signs. It names the link's own linkDigest, so it binds the exact link it acts on. Version 2 (AAB-PLATFORM-04, third amendment of 2026-09-28): names the key the writer signs with, registered in the public-key registry (AAB-PLATFORM-09). A new version 1 statement is refused.

signingKeyId.description: The writer's key in the public-key registry, lowercase.
